description:
On the /fly route, the HUD heliocentric speed readout displays 'NaN km/s' for the entire transit of outer-planet missions (destinations beyond Mars: Jupiter, Saturn, Neptune, Pluto, Ceres)

Expected: The HUD speed readout should show the spacecraft's real heliocentric orbital speed (a finite number in km/s) at every point along the transfer trajectory, for all destinations, including outer planets

Acceptance criteria:
- Flying any outer-planet mission (dest=JUPITER|SATURN|URANUS|NEPTUNE|PLUTO|CERES) on /fly must not produce NaN in the HUD speed readout at any frame position along the transfer arc [code-invariant: NaN is an unrecoverable display error; the app must never show NaN in a user-facing numeric readout]
- The HUD speed readout at the departure-body (Earth) distance (~1 AU) must match the vis-viva value for a Hohmann transfer from Earth to that destination: v = sqrt(μ * (2/1 - 1/a_transfer)) × AU/yr→km/s, where a_transfer = (R_EARTH_AU + R_DEST_AU) / 2 [spec: ADR-010 / AGENTS.md physics section: 'Transfer arc: Keplerian half-ellipses'; fly-physics.ts:29-33 documents the Hohmann vis-viva formula; static/data/planets.json and DESTINATIONS table in lambert-grid.constants.ts provide per-destination a values]
